about: W13.X6: every dependency with an install script (package-lock.json `hasInstallScript`) in every lockfile of the repo, and what happens to it now that .npmrc sets ignore-scripts=true. `allow`: run on purpose by `npm run supply:allowed-scripts`. `skip`: reviewed, not run, and why that is safe. scripts/supply/lockfile-check.mjs fails when a lockfile gains a package with an install script that is on neither list.

allow.name: esbuild
allow.why: postinstall swaps the JavaScript launcher for the platform binary from @esbuild/<platform> (faster start). esbuild also works without it.

skip.name: fsevents
skip.why: macOS only; ships a prebuilt binary, and the install script only rebuilds with node-gyp when that is missing.

skip.name: leveldown
skip.why: node-gyp-build loads the prebuilt binary at run time; the install script only compiles when no prebuild fits.

skip.name: classic-level
skip.why: as leveldown: prebuilt binaries, node-gyp-build at run time.

skip.name: @parcel/watcher
skip.why: prebuilt binaries through optionalDependencies; the install script is a node-gyp fallback.

skip.name: onnxruntime-node
skip.why: downloads CUDA binaries from nuget.org (.npmrc already skips it: onnxruntime-node-install=skip); unused in the browser build.

skip.name: protobufjs
skip.why: postinstall only checks the version scheme of its dependents; nothing is built.

skip.name: tesseract.js
skip.why: postinstall prints a funding message; OCR runs in the browser with its own wasm.
